mods.name: Synaptic
mods.description: One life, shared. Health, hunger, experience, status effects, advancements, pets, the inventory and the ender chest are pooled across everyone online — and if one player dies, everyone dies. Damage is called out in chat and heard by the whole group, hunger is split by player count, and a single sleeper skips the night. Press K in game, or use /synaptic, to switch any of it on or off.
